name: DLSS 4 Upscaler (WIP)
author: Echo-Storm
description: Preview (work in progress), off until you switch it on. Upscales with NVIDIA DLSS Super Resolution in place of Lossless Scaling's NIS scaler, on every frame it presents, real and generated: choose NIS as the Scaling Type and run the game in a window smaller than the screen. NVIDIA's DLSS runtime is included. It works beside DLSS 5 Neural Rendering.
